fields.calculatedFormula:
IF(
    AND(
        ISPICKVAL(Business_Type__c , "Change Order"),
        OR(
            ISPICKVAL(StageName,"Proposal in Progress"),
            ISPICKVAL(StageName,"Proposal Sent"),
            ISPICKVAL(StageName,"Bid Defence")
        )
    ),
    75,
    Probability
)
